rows.headline: RBI updates banks on UNSC Taliban sanctions list amendments
rows.hook: New UNSC terror entries filter to Indian lenders
rows.summary: The Reserve Bank of India issued a circular to commercial banks, NBFCs, and financial institutions on October 30, 2026, updating compliance obligations under Section 51A of the UAPA Act, 1967. The directive incorporates amendments made by the UN Security Council Committee under resolution 1988 (2011) regarding five entries on the Taliban Sanctions List. Regulated entities must verify their databases to ensure no accounts are held by the listed individuals. This is a routine regulatory compliance update for financial institutions operating in India.
rows.why_it_matters: Banks must screen customer databases for newly updated UN targets.
